component.name: Phosrack
component.summary: A compact modular music rack for Spotify
Un rack musical compacto y modular para Spotify
Un rack musical compact et modulaire pour Spotify

description.p: Phosrack is a desktop music rack inspired by classic modular media players. Its compact interface combines Spotify playback, search, queue and library views with an original live visualizer for your local audio output.

Configure your own Spotify developer Client ID and authorize your Premium account in the browser. Integrated playback uses the official Web Playback SDK inside Qt WebEngine and requires a compatible existing Widevine module, which is not bundled. An external Spotify player mode is also available. Spotify's application-access restrictions still apply.
The local ten-band equalizer offers editable presets and preamp control. A fullscreen visualizer displays current and upcoming track information.
Play Spotify inside Phosrack with Qt WebEngine and the official Web Playback SDK, or choose an external player in Settings.
Set up your own Client ID, detect or choose an existing Widevine module, and reconnect older sessions for the new playback permissions. No shared Spotify Client ID or Widevine module is bundled.
The compact rack keeps its phosphor styling and dedicated fullscreen visualizer, with a simpler title strip.
